authority: UN R100 Rev 4 / ISO 6469 / GB 44263 / SAE J2344

min_isolation_resistance_dc.name: Minimum DC Electrical Isolation Resistance
min_isolation_resistance_dc.description: UN R100 minimum required DC electrical isolation resistance per operating volt between live high-voltage bus and electrical chassis ground.

source.title: UN Regulation No. 100 — Uniform provisions concerning the approval of vehicles with regard to specific requirements for the electric power train
source.publisher: United Nations Economic Commission for Europe (UNECE)
source.revision: Revision 4 (04 series of amendments, OJ L 437/1)

provenance.verbatim: If AC high voltage buses and DC high voltage buses are galvanically isolated from each other, isolation resistance between the high voltage bus and the electrical chassis shall have a minimum value of 100 Ω/V of the working voltage for DC buses, and a minimum value of 500 Ω/V of the working voltage for AC buses.

isolation_resistance_testbed_threshold.name: Isolation Resistance Baseline @ 500 VDC
isolation_resistance_testbed_threshold.description: Minimum acceptable isolation resistance during Megohmmeter high-voltage test at 500 VDC test voltage across the isolated traction bus.

source.title: UN Regulation No. 100 / ISO 6469-1 Electrically propelled road vehicles — Safety specifications

provenance.verbatim: For isolation testing at 500 VDC test bench, baseline isolation shall be maintained at or above 7 MΩ before energization.

thermal_runaway_warning_advance.name: Thermal Runaway Advance Warning Time
thermal_runaway_warning_advance.description: Mandatory 5-minute (300 seconds) advance warning signal to occupants prior to hazardous thermal runaway event, cell venting, or fire propagation.

source.title: UN Regulation No. 100 — Specific requirements for the electric power train

provenance.verbatim: The vehicle shall provide a warning indication to the driver at least 5 minutes prior to the occurrence of a critical situation caused by thermal propagation in the REESS.

gm_field_normal_isolation.name: GM Fleet Normal Isolation Resistance
gm_field_normal_isolation.description: General Motors Ultium and BEV2 production baseline isolation resistance. Resistance below 500 kΩ sets warning; below 100 kΩ commands contactor open.
gm_field_normal_isolation.authority: General Motors High Voltage Service Diagnostic Specification / SAE J2344

source.title: GM Technical Service Bulletin — High Voltage Isolation System Diagnostic Guide (DTC P0AA6)

provenance.verbatim: Nominal high-voltage bus isolation resistance is approximately 6200 kΩ (6.2 MΩ) under dry ambient conditions.

tesla_hvil_nominal_current.name: Tesla HVIL Nominal Circuit Current
tesla_hvil_nominal_current.description: Tesla High Voltage Interlock Loop (HVIL) continuous pilot monitoring loop current. Operating band 15-25 mA; open-circuit fault trip <5 mA.
tesla_hvil_nominal_current.authority: Tesla Service & Diagnostic Manual Model 3/Y HVIL Circuit Specification

source.title: Tesla Model 3/Y Service Manual — High Voltage Safety Interlock Diagnostics

provenance.verbatim: HVIL controller sources a constant current of approximately 20 mA through the series circuit across all HV connectors and pyro-fuses.

gbt_control_pilot_pullup.name: GB/T 27930 DC Control Pilot Pull-Up Voltage
gbt_control_pilot_pullup.description: GB 44263-2024 and GB/T 27930-2023 DC charging control pilot (CP) circuit pull-up voltage: 12.0 V ±0.6 V.

source.title: GB 44263-2024 Electric vehicle conductive charging safety technical requirements / GB/T 27930-2023
source.publisher: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) / SAC

provenance.verbatim: DC charging control pilot pull-up voltage shall be 12 V with a tolerance not exceeding ±0.6 V.
